reviews.explanation: The mention 康伯 refers to 韓康伯. The main text explicitly names 韓康伯 as 丹陽尹, and the Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-004) explicitly refers to 太常韓康伯, confirming the identity. The alias registry evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-5b47db1abb6274feab06) links 康伯 as a courtesy-name form of 韓伯. The mother 母殷 addresses him as 康伯, consistent with the narrative. No contradicting evidence exists.

The mention 隱之 refers to 吳隱之. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-004) explicitly states '鄭緝孝子傳曰隱之字處默', confirming 隱之's identity. The canonical name match from people.json (sfh1-candidate-evidence-17174547625f11a942dd) supports this. The annotation explicitly identifies 隱之 as the younger Wu brother. No contradicting evidence.

The mention 太常韓康伯 refers to 韓康伯 holding the office of 太常. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-004) explicitly mentions '太常韓康伯', directly confirming this office-holder reference. The alias registry evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-dc20b81957546a0be9fc) links 康伯 to 韓伯. The main text also establishes 韓康伯 as a person who later became 吏部尚書, consistent with the office-holder identity. No contradicting evidence.

The mention 隱之 refers to 吳隱之. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-002) explicitly identifies 隱之 as the younger brother (小字附子 for 坦之, and 隱之小字 for the younger brother). The canonical name match from people.json (sfh1-candidate-evidence-bd5050058a727f825aed) supports this. The annotation explicitly identifies 隱之 as the younger Wu brother. No contradicting evidence.

The surface 韓康伯 appears in the main text as 丹陽尹 (Governor of Danyang). The alias registry maps 韓康伯 to 韓伯 (courtesy name 康伯). The main text explicitly identifies 韓康伯 as 丹陽尹 and later as 吏部尚書, consistent with the historical figure 韓伯. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-004) also refers to 太常韓康伯, confirming this identification. No contradicting evidence found.

The surface 汝 is a second-person pronoun used by 母殷 (mother Yin) addressing her son 韓康伯. The reference semantics explicitly state it corefers with 康伯 (sfh1-mention-71daa3ee4edc0c2b90c4bc0c) and is distinct from the speaker and from 此人 (the Wu brothers). The main text context '語康伯曰汝若為選官' confirms 汝 refers to 韓康伯. The alias registry maps 康伯 to 韓伯. This is a local anaphoric reference to the same person.

The surface 康伯 appears in the main text as the person addressed by 母殷 and who later becomes 吏部尚書. The Liu annotations (sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-004, -005) explicitly refer to 太常韓康伯 and 康伯, confirming this is the same person as 韓康伯/韓伯. The alias registry maps 康伯 as the courtesy name of 韓伯. The main text narrative is consistent: 韓康伯時為丹陽尹...語康伯曰...韓後果為吏部尚書. No contradicting evidence.

The surface 吳隱之 matches the canonical name in people.json. The Liu annotations explicitly identify 吳隱之 as the person discussed: annotation-004 mentions 隱之字處默, annotation-008 mentions 隱之乃至水上酌而飲之, and annotation-009 mentions 吳隱之為刺史自酌貪泉飲之. These annotations consistently refer to the same historical figure 吳隱之. The main text's 大吳/小吳 (the Wu brothers) context aligns with the annotation identifying 吳隱之 as one of the Wu brothers. No contradicting evidence.

The mention surface is 殷浩, and the candidate is 殷浩. The annotation sfh1-ev-01-dexing-047-liu-annotation-005 explicitly states '殷浩之妹' (sister of Yin Hao), referring to the mother of Han Kangbo. The name match is exact and the contextual role (殷浩 as the brother of the mother of Han Kangbo) is consistent with the historical figure Yin Hao. The evidence specifically supports this identity.

The mention surface is 隱之, the personal name of 吳隱之. The annotations explicitly identify 隱之 as the younger Wu brother (附子/隱之) and provide his courtesy name 處默 (annotation 004: '隱之字處默'). Annotation 005 continues the narrative about 隱之's filial conduct. The candidate evidence from people.json confirms 吳隱之 as the canonical name. The supporting evidence specifically identifies this person as 吳隱之.

The mention surface is 處默, which is the courtesy name (字) of 吳隱之. Annotation 004 explicitly states '隱之字處默' (Yinzhi's courtesy name is Chumo). The candidate is 吳隱之, and the evidence directly links the courtesy name 處默 to 隱之, who is 吳隱之. The identity is specifically supported by the annotation.

The mention surface is 隱之, appearing in annotation 009 immediately after the full name 吳隱之 in the same annotation text ('吳隱之為刺史自酌貪泉飲之'). This is a clear local anaphoric reference to the same person. The candidate is 吳隱之, and the evidence specifically shows the full name followed by the shortened form in the same passage, confirming identity.

The mention '隱之' is resolved to 吳隱之. The Liu annotation 004 explicitly states '隱之字處默少有孝行' (隱之, courtesy name 處默, had filial conduct from youth), and annotation 006 states '隱之既有至性加以廉㓗' (隱之 had innate nature plus incorruptibility). These annotations directly identify the person as 吳隱之. The main text describes the younger Wu brother (小吳) who became 大貴達 (greatly honored), and the annotations connect this to 吳隱之 who became 吏部尚書. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-46fbabb616712b8b7498) provides the canonical name 吳隱之 from people.json. The supporting annotations specifically describe 隱之's character and career trajectory matching the main text's account of the younger Wu brother. No contradicting evidence exists. The identification is well-supported by the supplied evidence.
